name: Address Book
summary: Passive native collection of saved address records with canonical default markers and target-owned actions.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Native unordered saved-address list and named inline-size container.

anatomy.name: record
anatomy.description: Native list item with a neutral non-interactive record surface.

anatomy.name: body
anatomy.description: Recipient, postal lines, and optional default marker.

anatomy.name: defaultTag
anatomy.description: Canonical passive Badge with the target-authoritative default label.

anatomy.name: name
anatomy.description: Recipient paragraph with automatic text direction.

anatomy.name: text
anatomy.description: Target-formatted postal lines rendered as direction-aware spans.

anatomy.name: actions
anatomy.description: Target-owned canonical Buttons or Links for one record.

anatomy.name: newAction
anatomy.description: Optional canonical add-address Button or Link in a final list item.

states.name: default
states.description: One or more complete saved-address records.

states.name: defaultAddressPresent
states.description: Zero or one record carries target-authoritative default truth and a visible canonical Badge.

states.name: actionsPresent
states.description: One or more target-owned record actions are composed.

states.name: newAddressPresent
states.description: A non-empty optional label adds one final canonical action item.

behavior.name: nativeCollection
behavior.description: Render saved records as a native unordered list without grid, listbox, option, selection, or roving-tabindex semantics.

behavior.name: completeCollection
behavior.description: Omit the complete renderer when the required collection is absent, empty, duplicate, or incomplete.

behavior.name: postalContent
attributes: dir=auto on recipient and each postal line
behavior.description: Use paragraphs rather than the HTML address element for arbitrary postal data and preserve target-formatted lines.

behavior.name: defaultAddress
behavior.description: Expose target-authoritative default truth with visible passive Badge text, not border or color alone.

behavior.name: addressActions
attributes: canonical native button or link semantics
accessible name includes visible label and record context
behavior.description: Add and Edit use canonical actions; navigation uses Link and commands/mutations use Button. Delete requires target confirmation or guaranteed undo. Set Default renders only when supported. Targets own capability, pending/error and mutation lifecycle.

behavior.name: protectedDeletion
behavior.description: A record remains present and ordered until authoritative deletion success. The target provides confirmation or guaranteed undo, status feedback, recovery and a deliberate focus destination.

behavior.name: authoritativeReconciliation
behavior.description: Records retain authoritative presence/order and the existing default marker through pending, cancellation, failure or undo availability. Successful target data may remove/reorder records or confirm at most one new default.

behavior.name: newAddress
behavior.description: A non-empty optional label adds a canonical action that targets may route to or disclose as Address Form.

behavior.name: passiveOwnership
behavior.description: Authentication, authorization, formatting, loading, empty, error, pending, confirmation/undo, concurrency, authoritative reconciliation, routing, deliberate focus restoration, announcements, and telemetry remain target composition.

behavior.name: responsiveContainer
behavior.description: Track count responds intrinsically to the component container while minimum track and add-action dimensions remain private.

properties.name: addresses
properties.description: Complete target-owned native collection of saved-address records and permitted per-record actions.

properties.name: newAddressLabel
properties.description: Non-empty visible accessible label for the optional add-address action.

accessibility: Protect and minimize address data through target authentication, authorization, and redaction before composition.
Use native unordered-list semantics for records and ordinary paragraphs for arbitrary postal addresses.
Default address state must be visible readable Badge text, not only color, and no more than one record may be default.
Repeated record actions need accessible names that contain their visible label and distinguish the affected address.
Canonical Button or Link owns focus, keyboard activation, disabled or busy state, forced colors, and reduced motion.

Delete requires target confirmation or an equivalent guaranteed undo path; keep the record present until authoritative success and restore focus deliberately after success, cancellation, undo, or failure.
Mutation feedback, concurrency, user-error recovery, default-address confirmation, and focus restoration remain target-owned outside the passive collection.

shopify.notes: Shopify v1 uses hosted Profile/Addresses as an intentional native handoff with no U6 parity claim. Target-controlled supplementary/full-page extensions or headless storefronts may project authoritative records and protected mutations with target-native components and Customer Account data, including B2B policy. Classic Liquid is separately versioned compatibility; copied CSS is not readiness.
